name: 92109 · San Diego, CA
findings: ZIP 92109 (San Diego) has 169 nonprofit organizations. 70 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 53 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92109 (San Diego) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92109 (San Diego) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 55 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
